Rules

  1. Self-Promotion:
    Self-promotion is completely fine. If you made some experimental music that you would like to share feel free to post it. Please limit to posting your original music at least once a month. Breaking this rule at all will result in a ban. See the ban section below for more info.

  2. Flairs:
    PLEASE IGNORE THIS RULE FOR NOW. ONLY MODS CAN PUT FLAIRS ON POSTS

  3. Rudeness:
    This is probably the most important rule (for me at least). This is a sub for discussing avant-garde music in a friendly environment. If you see someone being rude please report them (sending the permalink of the offending comment to me via mod-mail). Please don't confuse criticism for rudeness. Some discussions will be heated, that's unavoidable but please no name-calling, racial slurs, anything like that. If this happens at all it will be a ban.

  4. Titles:
    Try to keep titles in the 'Artist - Song Title' format. This isn't really a big deal, but the sub looks nicer that way. If you do post your own music don't write things like 'I just finished this song' or anything like that. Just keep it nice and simple. If you do have anything you want to say about your music or song you posted just put it in the comments. So, just keep the titles nice and simple.

Bans

Breaking some of the rules will result in a ban. When you get banned you can message the mods(me) to see if you can lift the ban. If you break the 1st rule, I will probably just give you a stern lecture and unban you, however, the 3rd rule is very important. If you break this rule at all the minimum ban-time is a day. Depending on the intensity(?) of the comment it could be longer. A serious violation of this rule will result in a life-time ban.

Suggestions

If you have any suggestions on things such as the subverse style or rules please let me know. I will try my best to implement them. As far as I know, having different fonts or colors for flairs is currently unavailable.
